title: DAO prefix authorization: origin_not_pinned shadows delegation reasons (6 red tests)
description: python/tests/rpl/test_dao_prefix_authorization.py: 6 tests fail with AssertionError 'origin_not_pinned' where the expected reason is delegation_expired / delegate_mismatch / target_mismatch / unsupported_transit. The DAO manager's origin-pin check fires before the delegation-specific validation, so the more informative delegation failure reason is shadowed. Affects: test_dao_prefix_authorization_allow_deny_matrix[self_host_route_allowed, foreign_host_route_rejected], test_delegated_foreign_host_route_allowed_after_seeding, test_delegation_is_bound_to_the_delegated_origin, test_expired_delegation_is_rejected_without_mutation, test_external_transit_rejected_without_mutation. Found while verifying yhbl (TxQueue) was already fixed; test_rpl_control_link_signatures.py passes.
close_reason: Fixed. Actual root cause differed from the bead's ordering diagnosis: the pin check did not merely shadow delegation reasons, it FAILED outright — fixtures keyed the pin table and delegation tokens by Identity.iid (SHA-512 link-local IID), while DaoOriginValidator looks up source_address.packed[8:16] and _authorize_delegated_target binds delegate_iid to the same bytes (sibling suite test_dao_origin.py pins by NODE_ADDR.packed[8:] throughout; rust enforces origin==ygg_addr_from_pubkey). Fixture-only repair (no assertions, no implementation changes): pin table + 3 token delegates now use routable-addr low bytes via NODE_DELEGATE/OTHER_DELEGATE constants. 12/12 pass; rpl 823 + crypto 761 green. 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases 1 low finding -> filed P3 follow-up; also filed P3 for trust.py stale addressing docstring; evidence comment on plqy.
